items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: We went to that meeting. Papa Celestine was there.

ctx.x: I didn't get to know him, but he... He died lately. He worked at that same bar room that George's sister had on. Yeah, that's it.

He was a great drummer also. In them brass bands. Oh, he was a great drummer. We went to that meeting. We went to that meeting. Papa Celestine was there. So they began playing records. Disgusting numbers. They played just certain numbers. And they asked George Bakke. Say, can you tell me who was playing that number? George didn't know his own number. George didn't know his own number. He was playing the clarinet. They played it. He said, you know who was that fella playing that clarinet in there? George said, no.…

Who got it? Who was that? Was that George Bakke then? Yeah, George Bakke. Was the first one that played that off the flute part. Do you remember who the march was by or was the piece by any composer? Do you remember? Was it published? No, no.
